```{r setup, include = FALSE}
for (p in c("_common.R", "../_common.R", "vignettes/_common.R"))
  if (file.exists(p)) { source(p); break }
```

Every shadshiny component, rendered live on one of the gallery pages below. Each
preview shows the real component alongside the exact source that produced it —
these are not screenshots. Previews follow the site's light/dark switch, so you
can see both modes without leaving the page.

New to the package? Read [Get started](shadshiny.html) first, then browse here.

## A taste

A few components, live — expand *Code* under any preview to see how it's built.

```{r}
demo({
  shad_button("Get started", icon = "arrow-right", icon_position = "right")
  shad_badge("New", icon = "check")
  shad_button("Outline", variant = "outline")
})
```

```{r}
demo(
  columns = TRUE,
  shad_alert(
    title = "It's all live",
    "Every preview on these pages is the real component, initialised in your browser.",
    icon = "info"
  )
)
```

## How the previews work

shadshiny components are plain `htmltools` tags that each carry the bundled
asset dependency. Rendering one in an article embeds the real CSS and JavaScript,
so the component initialises client-side exactly as it would in a running app —
dialogs open, tabs switch, carousels slide. Because dark mode keys off
`[data-bs-theme="dark"]` (which the navbar's light-switch toggles), the previews
recolour with the rest of the site. The [Theming](theming.html) guide explains
the token system behind that.
